title: Customer Liquidity Provision: Implications for Corporate Bond Transaction Costs
eligible_reason: Corporate-bond microstructure study. Main results are daily time-series regressions of spreads and trade-type shares, and trade-level felm with cusip, dealer and date FE on trade-type indicators. The only DiD-like comparison (20210301_daily_reg_DC_DC_bank.R) interacts a dealer-group or Volcker-affected indicator with common calendar subperiods, so the timing is common. No staggered binary adoption. Data are not shipped (Federal Reserve Board data contract).
design_notes: R and SAS code: clean_trace/ builds the TRACE sample, NAIC_code/ handles insurer trades (felm customer-year and transaction-level regressions), and the root has time-series and matched-trade regressions. lm(frac_DC_DC ~ index_vol + vix + not_affected + not_affected:period) with period = cut(date, subperiod_cutoff).
data_access: restricted (regulatory TRACE with dealer IDs under Federal Reserve Board contract; NAIC Schedule D licensed)
data_files_note: README.pdf: 'Data files are not included in the zip file because of the data contract terms of the Federal Reserve Board.'
priority_note: Not a staggered DiD; no data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
